description: CRA reasonable per-kilometre allowance rates for employer-paid vehicle allowances (2026 default; 2025 also available): first 5,000 km and after, provinces vs territories. Optionally calculates the allowance for a number of business kilometres. Returns structuredContent with the per-km rates for provinces and territories, the rates for the given region, an optional tiered calculation, the source and an as-of date.
